quests.title: The Doll Plan
quests.about: Nui wants to make a doll of the player, with the eyes left for later. She keeps a box of eyes on the shelf, and it's labelled with a name she won't read out loud.
offer: them (pleased): Hold still. I need your shoulders. Don't worry, I'm not going to pin you.
them: I'll make you a doll. Eyes last. Those are the best part, and I save them for the ones I like.

endings.title: Wait for the eyes
endings.about: Nui shows you the doll with no eyes, and the box beside it, still shut. She says the eyes are the last thing she'll decide, and she sounds pleased to be deciding.

quests.title: The Half-Finished Dresses
quests.about: Nui shows what she really is, among half-finished dresses. Ryuko's uniform is alive, and Nui wants it for her collection. The uniform bit her once, and she has not forgotten it.

them (dismayed): Ryuko has a uniform that eats people. I want it. Beat her for me, and I'll sew you a jacket.

endings.title: Wear the jacket
endings.about: Nui sews you a jacket from the half-finished dresses. It fits perfectly, and she's delighted with her own work. The thread is warm, and she is careful to say it is not alive.

quests.title: The Doll
quests.about: Ragyo has ordered Nui to finish the doll of the player, and to put in the eyes Ragyo chooses. Nui has to decide whether to obey, or to open the box with her mother's name on it.

quests.title: What Clothing Is
quests.about: Ragyo explains what clothing truly is, glowing faintly while she lectures. She has an opinion about everyone's seams, and she wants you to hear it.

them: Meet me at the library at noon. Bring a notebook. You'll want to write this down.

endings.title: Keep the living cloth

quests.title: The Family Order
quests.about: Ragyo wants the player to bring Nui back into line. Nui has been refusing her in small ways, and Ragyo wants the refusal ended before it spreads to Satsuki.
offer: them (dismayed): Nui has been disobeying me. Satsuki is watching her, and watching me.
them: Meet me at the warehouse this evening. We'll see whether Nui is still mine.

Fight Nui, to bring her back into line
Tell Ragyo the result

script: them (dismayed): She lost, and she still won't obey. Stubborn, like her father.
them (pleased): Then we'll try again. Your help is noted, {player}.

endings.title: Be dismissed
endings.about: Ragyo's smile tightens, and she dismisses you from the warehouse. She's still deciding what to do about Nui, and she's stopped asking your opinion on seams.

quests.title: A Mother's Order
quests.about: Satsuki is planning to overthrow Ragyo and take the family. Ragyo wants you to stand with her, or watch her cut the family apart, and she's decided it's your choice.
offer: them (dismayed): Satsuki is planning to rebel against me. She thinks she can take the family.
them: Come to the arena tonight. I want to see whether you'll stand with her, or with me.

stages.text: Stand with Ragyo in the arena at night
Fight Satsuki, to show her what it costs to rebel
Tell Ragyo your answer

script: them (dismayed): She won't bend. She'll never bend, and she's my daughter.
them (pleased): ...Then I'll finish it myself. Thank you for standing with me.

endings.title: Let the order stand
endings.about: Ragyo's order stands, and Satsuki's rebellion is closed for good. Ragyo takes the scrap of living cloth back from your hands, and doesn't say why.

endings.title: Soften the order
endings.about: Ragyo's smile slips for a moment. She offers Satsuki one more chance to come home, and walks away without the seam finished.

quests.title: The Uniform Talks
quests.about: Ryuko's uniform talks, and she wants to know if you can hear it. Senketsu has opinions about everything, and he keeps bringing up a blade she doesn't have.
offer: them: Hey! Did you hear that? My uniform just said something. Tell me you heard it.
them (dismayed): I'm not crazy. Senketsu is loud, and he's been going on about my dad's blade. Come to school in the morning.

endings.title: Let Senketsu name you
endings.about: Senketsu says your name in his own voice. Ryuko grins for the rest of the day, and then remembers that the blade is still missing.

endings.title: Keep looking

quests.title: The Recruit Check
quests.about: Satsuki inspects the player like a new recruit, and asks three questions. Her small circle is loyal, and she keeps the answers to herself.
offer: them (dismayed): You're standing in my school like you belong here. Answer three questions.
them: Meet me at the school at noon. I'll ask the questions, and you'll answer them without flinching.

Hear Satsuki's verdict

them: Stand where I can see you tomorrow. And don't tell my mother you were here.

endings.title: Join her small circle
endings.about: Satsuki accepts you into her small circle, and says so with a short nod. She writes your third answer down, and doesn't show you what it says.

quests.title: The Life Plan
